# DateField

> A typed DD/MM/YYYY field with a calendar popover, min/max and a date-of-birth preset.

Category: Forms. Docs page: https://rime.mjsons.net/components/date-field

## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add <owner>/rime/date-field
```

DateField accepts typing (DD/MM/YYYY, day first) or picking from Calendar. preset="dob" opens on a sensible year with a year dropdown, for dates decades back.

## Usage

```tsx
import { DateField } from "@/components/ui";

<Field label="Due date"><DateField value={due} onChange={setDue} /></Field>
```

## Examples

### Open

inline shows the calendar open under the field, in place.

```tsx
<DateField inline aria-label="Due date" value={due} onChange={setDue} />
```

### Default

```tsx
<DateField value={date} onChange={setDate} min="2026-01-01" />
```

Per-component tokens. Undeclared by default: the default below is the fallback the CSS uses. Set any of them at :root or on a wrapper to restyle every instance.

| Token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--field-focus-border` | `rgba(var(--rgb-brand), 0.7)` / `var(--focus-color)` |
| `--field-focus-ring` | `var(--focus-halo)` |

System tokens it reads: `--brand`, `--brand-gradient`, `--danger-ink`, `--dur`, `--dur-fast`, `--ease`, `--ease-out`, `--focus-color`, `--focus-halo`, `--focus-ring`, `--font-body`, `--glow-sm`, `--ink-body`, `--ink-brand`, `--ink-disabled`, `--ink-heading`, `--ink-inverse`, `--ink-muted`, `--line`, `--line-brand`, `--line-brand-strong`, `--r-xl`, `--r-xs`, `--rgb-brand`, `--rgb-brand-deep`, `--shadow-float`, `--surface-solid`, `--text-micro`, `--wash-active`, `--wash-hover`, `--wash-strong`, `--wash-subtle`, `--z-popover`.

## Accessibility

- The calendar is a grid with arrow-key navigation; Esc returns focus to the field.

## Do

- Always let people type a date of birth; never force a calendar for it.

## Don't

- Don't mix date orders within one product.
